abstract: Maintains acoustic abatement installations and perimeter sound emission records
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance inspector (ENV). The Environmental compliance inspector (ENV) maintains acoustic abatement installations and perimeter sound emission records, while tracking secondary containment compliance across candidate dewatering units.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fluid bunding secondary containment（SPILL）
information_points.content:
ENV-SPILL-TYX：The Vortex High-Head Centrifugal Barge records a bunding retention margin of 110% relative to total fluid reservoir capacity.
ENV-SPILL-KC6：The Delta Axial-Flow Submersible Pontoon maintains a bunding retention margin of 120% relative to total fluid reservoir capacity.
ENV-SPILL-PFU：The Hydro-Flo Archimedean Skiff provides a bunding retention margin of 130% relative to total fluid reservoir capacity.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic abatement installations and perimeter sound emission records（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-ACOUST-NNR：For the Delta Axial-Flow Submersible Pontoon, under the assessment basis including secondary exhaust silencer baffles, an acoustic enclosure barrier is installed on the diesel engine and hydraulic pump drive assembly.
ENV-ACOUST-KQ3：For the Delta Axial-Flow Submersible Pontoon, under the assessment basis excluding secondary exhaust silencer baffles, an acoustic enclosure barrier is not installed.
ENV-ACOUST-2JO：For the Vortex High-Head Centrifugal Barge, evaluated under the basis including secondary exhaust silencer baffles, an acoustic enclosure barrier is not installed on the diesel engine and hydraulic pump drive assembly.
ENV-ACOUST-IUJ：For the Hydro-Flo Archimedean Skiff, evaluated under the basis including secondary exhaust silencer baffles, an acoustic enclosure barrier is installed on the diesel engine and hydraulic pump drive assembly.
